messages:
Maya: quick sync — sales/legal pushed for explicit upgrade SLAs in contracts for private deploy. They want max maintenance window, rollback guarantee, and a signed migration checklist customers can attach to their change control. Thoughts?

Nate: agreed. From product perspective we can offer two tiers: Standard (best-effort rolling upgrade, 30m recovery target) and Enterprise (tested canary + guaranteed 5m rollback window, IP reservation manifest, KMS-backed exports). Need to map features to pricing.

Elaine: field note — several customers refused to upgrade because their firewall owners require a signed manifest of egress IPs 24h ahead. We should include a pre-cutover reservation manifest step and an optional pre-provision API so they can request ephemeral reservations.

Samir: technical feasibility: we can generate reservation manifests from relay-gateway and vpc-controlled profiles. tenant-nat is harder because of shared NAT pools; we could produce a predicted mapping and a confidence score. Example manifest format:
```json
{ "service": "inference", "egress_ips": ["198.51.100.2"], "valid_from":"2026-05-01T03:00Z" }
```
We need to sign that with customer KMS.

security: must ensure manifests are signed and encrypted using customer-managed keys or a per-customer KMS envelope. Audit logs are mandatory. Add retention spec for exports to contracts.

Maya: delivery/prioritization: propose contractable features in phases: Phase A (vpc-controlled + reservation manifest + signed export), Phase B (relay egress-preserve + deterministic canaries), Phase C (tenant-nat predicted mapping + IPAM integration). Phase A highest priority for Q2.

Nate: rollout criteria to include in contracts: - acceptance tests pass in customer's staging (egress-stability >= 99.9%), - upgrade runbook executed once with ops, - post-upgrade verification run. Include measurable SLOs.

Elaine: add field requirement: include a fallout playbook for customers that fail their firewall pre-checks (auto-revert option + incident contact). Many Ops teams need the human-in-loop fallback.

Samir: action items: - prototype manifest generator & signer (owner: samir) - mapping of features -> contract tiers (owner: nate) - runbook + legal-friendly checklist (owner: maya) - KMS + audit integration (owner: security).

release-bot: scheduled canary deploy for profile=vpc-controlled job=7210 tomorrow 02:00 UTC :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Maya: thanks all. I'll draft a contract appendix template that lists launch gates and the migration checklist. Meeting tomorrow 09:30 to finalize. @nate @elaine bring two customer examples each. Closing thread.
